A model type is the model_type in a HuggingFace repo's config.json, such as gpt_oss.
Its definition says what every repo of that type needs on each engine: files to
fetch, flags to add, chat template fixes. 'new' applies it to the profile it writes.
They ship in the binary, and a file in <config>/model-types.d adds one or replaces
a shipped one with the same id, without a rebuild.

## Usage

```console
llm-helper model-types
```
